label: DIVE_ANALYZER_SUBJECT_RESOLUTION_V1
gt_usage: GT chains (target_chains_v1.json) used for EVALUATION ONLY; zero GT enters inference; zero new embeddings, detections or training

phase3_persontrack_construction.mechanism: union-find agglomerative merge over all plausible floor-candidate tracklets; merge if endpoint IoU>=0.3 OR cos>=0.80 with temporal gap<=0.5s
phase3_persontrack_construction.fragmentation: subject spans 15-161 distinct tracklets per dive; longest single tracklet run: 2169 5.69s, 2341 0.55s
phase3_persontrack_construction.finding: SUBJECT IS REACHABLE: on every ordinary dive some tracklet/track contains every GT subject frame; but naive merge collapses subject and distractors into one mega-cluster (same failure mode as V4 bounded-degree linkage)

phase5_junk_taxonomy.mechanism: area<0.02 or span<0.7s+conf<0.05 -> NON_PERSON_LIKELY; static-stable person-sized -> PERSON_NON_DIVER_POSSIBLE; moving excursion>=0.20 rel-frame units span>=0.33s -> VALID_PERSON_TRACK; else UNKNOWN
phase5_junk_taxonomy.finding: junk elimination is SAFE-BY-CONSTRUCTION for movers (VALID_PERSON_TRACK preserved); the binding problem is choosing among hundreds of surviving person tracks, not junk

phase7_r0_within_clip_reference.design: acquire a GT-free stable reference tracklet per clip (flow-compensated, cy_std<=0.03, span>=2s), then retrieve subject by OSNet cos

oracle_ceiling.note: best reference among all stable tracklets, chosen with GT (diagnostic ceiling)

gt_free_acquisition_rules_tested: later-displacement-topology (candidate near the stable track that later moves)
phase7_r0_within_clip_reference.diagnosis: correct references have median area 0.038-0.05 but rank 16-79 by area/span/score; NO tested property separates them from wrong stable tracks on 4/5 dives; only 2169 admits a GT-free rule (max-conf stable, 0.885-0.871)

phase7_r1_cross_clip_gallery.design: use a stable reference from ANOTHER dive of the same diver as gallery reference
phase7_r1_cross_clip_gallery.diagnosis: cross-athlete reference cos (0.59-0.79) overlaps same-athlete cross-clip cos (0.64-0.81) and distractor cos (0.6-0.8); raw OSNet cos is not identity-separative across clips
phase7_r1_cross_clip_gallery.verdict: REFERENCE_R1_GALLERY = REJECTED (confirms audit H1b; no new factor changes separability)

phase8_subject_conditioned_matching_with.design: frame-level OSNet cos against oracle stable reference; per-frame top-1 subject or not
phase8_subject_conditioned_matching_with.twin_track_warning: 1040: second-best track cos 0.967 is 0.881 subject-fraction while the best (0.977) is a non-subject static twin; 2341: 230 (0.946, subj 0.963) vs ref track 120 (0.944)

decision.architecture: PREFERRED_ARCHITECTURE = OPTION_D_HYBRID (PersonTracks -> junk elimination -> subject-conditioned resolution) CONFIRMED
decision.primary_lock: GT-FREE REFERENCE ACQUISITION, not PersonTrack construction
decision.honest_statement: PersonTrack construction achieves near-complete subject coverage but naive merging is degenerate; the actual bottleneck moved to acquiring a discriminative reference without ground truth. All bounded GT-free acquisition mechanisms tested this cycle failed on 4/5 dives; raw OSNet cos cannot separate identities across clips (R1 rejected). Per supervisor directive the protocol was NOT changed to chase this; it is reported as the open problem.
decision.next_learning_problem: TRAIN_SUBJECT_CONDITIONED_MATCHER (remains); plus NEW: reference-acquisition signal study (e.g. temporal position priors relative to dive phases, board-occupancy topology, or a learned stable-reference scorer) - bounded proposals only, LOSO-by-dive, no random frame splits
decision.abstention: ambiguity margins (p50 0.008-0.05) make abstention thresholds feasible-in-principle once a real reference exists; expect need for learned margin calibration

tests: 33/33 pass (20 metadata incl. 5 phantom-repair regression + 13 audit)
